_note: EXAMPLE ONLY. Copy to config/candidates.json and fill in by hand. The ingest job never chooses candidates; a person applies the rule below and records which races were considered.

selection_rule.races: Exactly 3 completed (past) races, all at the same office level (for example, all state senate seats).
selection_rule.per_race: 2 candidates per race, from different parties.
selection_rule.outcomes: Include both the winner and a losing candidate in each race. Do not pick by expected position on any topic.
selection_rule.how_races_are_chosen: Write down the pool of races considered and the reason each was picked or skipped, before looking at what any candidate said.
selection_rule.same_treatment: Every candidate gets the same source types, the same script and the same per-candidate cap (ingest/settings.json).
